mapper.select: SELECT fno, poster, name, rdays, rownum FROM (SELECT fno, poster, name, rdays FROM project_food WHERE type LIKE '%'||#{type}||'%' ORDER BY hit DESC) WHERE rownum<=50
SELECT time FROM reserve_day WHERE rno=#{rno}
SELECT time FROM reserve_time WHERE tno=#{tno}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reserve_info VALUES( (SELECT NVL(MAX(rno)+1,1) FROM reserve_info), #{id},#{fno},#{day},#{time},#{inwon}, SYSDATE, 'n' )
mapper.select: SELECT rno, ri.fno, day, ri.time, inwon, isok, poster, address, phone, TO_CHAR(regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as dbday FROM reserve_info ri, project_food pf WHERE ri.fno=pf.fno AND id=#{id} ORDER BY rno DESC
SELECT rno, ri.fno, day, ri.time, inwon, isok, poster, address, phone, TO_CHAR(regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as dbday FROM reserve_info ri, project_food pf WHERE ri.fno=pf.fno ORDER BY rno DESC

SELECT rno, day, ri.time, inwon, regdate, TO_CHAR(regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as dbday, name, poster, address, phone, score, content, theme FROM reserve_info ri, project_food pf WHERE ri.fno=pf.fno AND rno=#{rno}
